summary: Short corner kerb at a junction, house 9 m away, no-stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses directly behind the kerb, nearest 9 m; fully exposed at a junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs into the junction mouth; stretch is too short and awkward for a van to stand clear.
drivers.traffic: Busy road junction with turn lanes and a median island.
drivers.convention: Three No Stopping Any Time signs nearby; cars park further along Keltie Street but not on this corner.

flags: Signs say No Stopping Any Time (Miskin and Keltie Streets)
sun_shade: Open, with a house shading the north side early.
